name: 28 DOMINOES
description: 28 dominoes is block or draw dominoes with a double-6 set of 28 tiles. Two to five players; 7 tiles each (2-3 players) or 5 (4-5 players). Highest double leads. Match numbers on open ends; doubles placed crosswise. Block: pass if cannot play. Draw: draw from boneyard until you can play. First out wins; or lowest pips if blocked.

Domino tiles originated in China in the 12th–13th centuries; the modern 28-tile double-six block and draw games developed in France and spread across Europe and worldwide.
Double-6 domino set of 28 tiles: each tile has two ends with 0–6 pips; every combination appears once. Used for block and draw games.
7 each (2-3 players) or 5 each (4-5); rest boneyard.

items.text: Block dominoes: Standard blocking game with a double-six set: each player draws an initial hand, plays matching tiles to the open ends, and passes when unable to play; the winner is first to play all tiles or the player with the lowest pip total when the game is blocked.

Draw dominoes: Draw variant using the same double-six set: when a player cannot play they must draw from the boneyard until they find a playable tile or the stock is empty; scoring still uses the remaining pips in opponents' hands.
